caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot positioned in the center of the composition, viewed from the side, with its spout pointing to the right and its handle on the left. The teapot has a bulbous body, a wide, slightly flared ribbed base, a long, slender spout, and a large, rounded handle. The lid is domed with a small knob at the top and decorative ridges on its circumference. Elaborate scrollwork and foliage motifs adorn the main body of the teapot, with a central crest or shield that features a lion. To the lower right of the teapot, there is a circular inset illustration showing the top view of the teapot's lid, decorated with concentric patterns of leaves, floral elements, and a central rosette. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray pencil or graphite on lightly yellowed paper, with fine detailing and shading giving the objects a three-dimensional effect. The image is framed by a single line border, and in the lower right corner, the name "V. Carrano" is inscribed.
title: Silver Teapot
